description: agent.rows is the management table's read and the daemon's first adopter of the paging convention (docs/aeon/PAGING.md, PG1–PG5): the request is the five keys page, pageSize, sort, dir and q, and the answer echoes those five as the daemon APPLIED them beside the rows, plus `total` — the count of the FILTERED set, taken before the window. The rows are the nine columns a list can honestly hold; `prompt`, `skills` and `metadata` are deliberately absent, because a chooser that ships every row's content is a page that loads the whole store into the browser, and an edit form seeded from this row would blank the fields it never showed — which is exactly why the panel opens a row with agent.view (S73 AR5).
